---
name: Bug report
description: Report a regression without sharing account or conversation data.
labels: [bug]
---

## Version and environment
Application version/code; device model; OS/build; GeckoView or ArkWeb version; input method; Android compatibility runtime if applicable.

## Reproduction
Steps using synthetic data only.

## Expected / actual
Describe the difference from the original website where relevant.

## Evidence
Sanitized logs/screenshots, artifact SHA-256, reproduction frequency.

## Safety
Confirm no prompts, cookies, auth tokens, personal files or sign-in codes included.
